title: Multiple religions talk about the astral plane—some even refer to it simply as Heaven. If it is confirmed there’s a type of dream you can experience this realm, then Heaven would come to Earth by an internal process, just as Jesus prophesied. And that’s only the beginning of what would unfold...

classification.theory_summary: Proposes Mall World dreams are access to an astral 'celestial city' (Heaven/New Jerusalem/Devapura) and reframes rapture language as dream-based 'being taken'; suggests only some people experience it due to readiness/role in spiritual conflict.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream episode(s) described; content is primarily religious/theoretical framing with only general statements (e.g., 'overwhelming/intense/terrifying') not tied to specific locations, sequences, or sensory details.

meta.author_theory: Mallworld dreams may be entry into an astral 'celestial metropolis' identified with Heaven/New Jerusalem/Devapura; not everyone is 'taken' (enters it) and some are shielded until emotionally ready; the city includes hostile beings and a war that must be won before it becomes paradise.

extraction.extraction_notes: The post contains generalized phenomenological adjectives about a 'Celestial City' (e.g., 'overwhelming, intense, and even terrifying' and 'heartwarming and amazing experiences') but provides no specific dream scenes, sensory details (light, layout, crowding), or navigable locations/connections to extract into location-level records without interpretation.
